recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the Published Jira correction without changing conformance expectations; no separate FHIR-12524 action is needed because that issue is only supporting history for why SUBSETTED remains a tag.
issue_request: FHIR-20672 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core-http and asked that the _summary read paragraph stop referring to SUBSETTED as a "Simple Tag" because the target Resource page defines Tags, not a separate Simple Tag concept.
initial_application: A historical FHIR-20672-labeled commit, cb8df9fa71848ce2c859378ab59f36b97cd08fd6, only removed an extra Resource page anchor. The current source still retained the disputed "Simple Tag" wording in source/http.html before this reconciliation.
additional_context: FHIR-12524 established that SUBSETTED belongs in Resource.meta.tag rather than Meta.security, so the semantic recommendation needed to remain a tag recommendation. The Resource notes already expose resource.html#tags as the Tags section, and a 2020 Zulip thread independently confirmed that implementers could not find a definition for "Simple Tag".
reconciliation: Changed source/http.html to say the SUBSETTED code is used as a tag and to link to resource.html#tags. The edit is limited to removing the undefined label while preserving the meta.tag guidance.
source_changes: source/http.html: updated the _summary read guidance from "SUBSETTED as a Simple Tag" linking to resource.html#simple-tags to "SUBSETTED code as a tag" linking to resource.html#tags.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue that changed SUBSETTED from a security label recommendation to Resource.meta.tag; it constrains FHIR-20672 to a wording/link fix rather than a semantic change.
